snippet.title: Last Bone - Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
📌 Available Now on Meta Quest — Last Bone: https://www.meta.com/en-gb/experiences/last-bone/25415738261360858/
📌 Join Discord for Community & Updates: Discord.gg/lastbone

Step into Last Bone, the chaotic multiplayer VR brawler where attitude-filled skeletons collide in a surreal steampunk arena of pure mayhem. Draw your weapon blind boxes, pull out unpredictable gear, and jump into wild, laugh-out-loud battles where every round feels fresh, frantic, and fun.

Why Last Bone?

CHAOTIC MULTIPLAYER BATTLES
 Fight, dodge, prank, and outplay friends in fast, ridiculous skeleton combat.

WEAPON BLIND BOXES
 Draw weapons at random — from harmless-looking toys to world-ending chaos sticks.

RHYTHM-BLIND BOXES
 The Skeleton Band reacts to your moves, turning every fight into a music-fueled performance.

ABSURD STYLE & CUSTOMIZATION
 Collect outrageous skins and gear to show off your personality.

MORE MADNESS COMING
 New weapons, new outfits, new nonsense — constantly updated.

Get ready for chaos. Get ready for bones.

#lastbonevr #vr #quest2 #quest3 #quest3s #vrgame #vrgaming #vrgames #metaquest #metaquest #metaquest #metaquest2 #metaquest3 #virtualreality #oculus
